import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the result structure
class GslSfResult(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', ctypes.c_double), ('err', ctypes.c_double)]

# Define the function prototype
# double gsl_sf_bessel_I0(const double x)
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_I0.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_I0.restype = ctypes.c_double

def compute_bessel_I0(x):
    """Compute the modified Bessel function of the first kind of order zero."""
    return gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_I0(ctypes.c_double(x))
